D/14 CLCON No.717 of 2025
Hon'ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
 Mr. Neeraj Parihar, Advocate for the
petitioner.
 Mr. Devesh Ghildiyal, Brief Holder for the
State of Uttarakhand.
 The petitioner has brought to the
notice of the Court that the order
dated18.09.2025, passed in WPSS
no.2219 of 2023 has been wilfully
disobeyed by the respondent, by which,
the representation of the petitioner was to
be decided with the liberty to the
petitioner to make fresh representation
with further direction to the Competent
Authority to take a decision within three
months.
 The petitioner has himself enclosed the
Annexure No.5, the order passed by the
Competent Authority, by which, the
representations dated 20.09.2025 and
23.09.2025 of the petitioner have been
rejected. If the petitioner is aggrieved by
the decision taken on the representations,
he may very well take such recourse as
provided under the law.
 Since the order has been complied
with, nothing survives in this contempt
petition. It stands disposed of accordingly.

(Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 03.01.2026
Sanjay
